52:32.text: Do their minds command them this
[i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)]
or are they people transgressing all bounds?

52:34.text: Let them then produce a recital like unto it

52:35.text: Were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?

52:36.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.

52:37.text: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?

52:38.text: , by means of which they listen
? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.

52:39.text: only daughters and you have sons?

52:40.text: so that they are burdened with a load of debt?

52:41.text: is with them, and they write it down?

52:42.text: Or do they intend a plot
(against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)

52:43.text: other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners

52:44.text: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

52:45.text: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting

52:46.text: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped
(i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell)

52:47.text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment
(i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves)
before this; but most of them know not.

52:48.text: for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes
; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.

52:49.text: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.
